fullContentHtml:
RRB NTPC CEN 06/2025 Graduate Level CBTST Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the CBTST Admit Card for the Non Technical Popular Categories NTPC Graduate Level posts. RRB has invited huge number of vacancies for NTPC Graduate Level post recruitment during the 16 March 2026 to 27 March 2026. There were 5,810 posts were called for the hiring of RRB NTPC Graduate Level in various trades. The CBTST examination is going to be conducted in September 2026. Candidates who qualified for CBT II examination can check their RRB NTPC CEN 06/2025 Graduate Level CBTST Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
